The '''Panther police interceptor''' was an [[airspeeder]] utilized by the [[Coruscant Security Force]] for [[Law enforcement agency|law enforcement]] operations on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]].

==Description==
The [[Coruscant]] police speeder was utilized by [[police officer]]s and [[GU-series Guardian police droid]]s of the [[Coruscant Security Force]] to assist in patrolling Coruscant during the [[Clone Wars]].<ref name="TCW_PoP" /> It was operated by a single pilot and could carry two passengers. The back compartment had bars for prisoner transport. The side of the vehicle listed the jurisdiction. It had a set of [[Color|red]] and blue police lights on top.<ref name="Encyclopedia Starfighters" />

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars]], police droids utilized the Panther to pursue [[bounty hunter]]s [[Chata Hyoki]] and [[Robonino]], who had been hired by [[Count]] [[Dooku]] to attack [[Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]]. Police forces chased the two through Coruscant's [[skylane]]s but failed to apprehend them.<ref name="TCW_PoP" />

==Behind the scenes==
The police cruiser made their first visual appearance in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars TV series'']] episode "[[Pursuit of Peace]]." The cruisers in the episode are shown to belong to [[Coruscant police sector 417]].<ref name="TCW_PoP" />
